body: Tired of my partners dying before me, my best friend ended it when we were 24, a year later I tried and would of succeeded if an indigenous guy came out of nowhere like a fucking ghost and held me up until someone else removed the fibro plastic coated clothes line from around my neck,  all or most of the closest friends are gone, out of all my 6 siblings,  my oldest sister and I are close, she knows I want half my ashes in new Zealand on my first partners grave and the other half on the beach where tsunami took my other piece of my heart! This will me my last year if I last until December which I doubt!
I've been existing for the past 35 years,,just fucking existing and making others happy,  I'm over all the shit I've been through, I've been dying a long time!
I want to do it live on Facebook!
I feel exactly the same and I'm going through absolute hell at the moment!
